records.name: Tuck Entryfold
records.biography_en: The passport was valid until he unfolded the final page. It had arrived ahead of its owner.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The passport was valid until he unfolded the final page. It had arrived ahead of its owner.

records.name: Mara Tagwise
records.biography_en: Mara found my luggage before the flight landed. She advised against opening it in this timeline.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: Mara found my luggage before the flight landed. She advised against opening it in this timeline.

records.name: Otto Ringcoin
records.biography_en: He offered change in three smaller orbits. I am still waiting for one to come back.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He offered change in three smaller orbits. I am still waiting for one to come back.

records.name: Edwin Jarhush
records.biography_en: He had nothing to declare except the weather inside his jar. The lid disagreed audibly.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He had nothing to declare except the weather inside his jar. The lid disagreed audibly.

records.name: Nell Starwelcome
records.biography_en: The stars indicate a very warm welcome. She removed a fourth after I asked for directions.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The stars indicate a very warm welcome. She removed a fourth after I asked for directions.

records.name: Pip Tonguetune
records.biography_en: The funnel translated his apology into a further incident. He has asked for a quieter language.
